name: vLLM KV block reuse-gap histogram
notes: vLLM main, PrometheusStatLogger in vllm/v1/metrics/loggers.py, read 2026-10-04. On by default (EngineArgs.disable_log_stats defaults False); served at :8000/metrics. Bucket family name in --custom-histogram-buckets: kv_cache_residency. NOT ON BY DEFAULT: requires --kv-cache-metrics (ObservabilityConfig.kv_cache_metrics, default False), which also requires log stats. Sampled at --kv-cache-metrics-sample, default 0.01 (1% of blocks) - so a rate computed from these is a sampled estimate, not a census.
